source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT (SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'SIU_Data_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPE_SIU_ExclusionData' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Get_Daily_Snapshot_of_Exclusion_Data150_') AS SIU_Data_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'SIU_Data_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPE_SIU_ExclusionData' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Get_Daily_Snapshot_of_Exclusion_Data150_') AS SIU_Data_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPE_SIU_ExclusionData' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Get_Daily_Snapshot_of_Exclusion_Data150_') AS OLE_DB_Destination_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPE_SIU_ExclusionData' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Get_Daily_Snapshot_of_Exclusion_Data150_') AS OLE_DB_Destination_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_Get_Daily_Snapshot_of_Exclusion_Data150__source_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPE_SIU_ExclusionData' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_Get_Daily_Snapshot_of_Exclusion_Data150_') AS OLE_DB_Destination_Get_Daily_Snapshot_of_Exclusion_Data150__source_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_Get_Daily_Snapshot_of_Exclusion_Data150__source_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPE_SIU_ExclusionData' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_Get_Daily_Snapshot_of_Exclusion_Data150_') AS OLE_DB_Destination_Get_Daily_Snapshot_of_Exclusion_Data150__source_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_Get_Daily_Snapshot_of_Exclusion_Data150__sink_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPE_SIU_ExclusionData' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_Get_Daily_Snapshot_of_Exclusion_Data150_') AS OLE_DB_Destination_Get_Daily_Snapshot_of_Exclusion_Data150__sink_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_Get_Daily_Snapshot_of_Exclusion_Data150__sink_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPE_SIU_ExclusionData' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_Get_Daily_Snapshot_of_Exclusion_Data150_') AS OLE_DB_Destination_Get_Daily_Snapshot_of_Exclusion_Data150__sink_TableName;

SELECT DISTINCT  	s.NPI 	,s.TIN     , 'CIMS-SIU' AS EXCLUSION_TYPE     , CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE(), 103) AS EPE_EXCLUDE_BEGIN_DT     , '12/31/9999' AS EPE_EXCLUDE_END_DT     , 'N' AS EDIT_FLAG     , CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE(),103) AS LOAD_DT     , 'ADRS/SYSPROGRAM' AS LOADED_BY     , w.pxCreateOpName AS INVESTIGATOR FROM GBDCLMRPT.CIMS.Work w             left join GBDCLMRPT.CIMS.Work_SubjectList s on w.pzInsKey=s.pzInsKey WHERE w.CASESTATUS in ('Open','Conditionally Closed') AND (s.NPI IS NOT NULL OR S.TIN IS NOT NULL)
